title: Itrone yeNyaniso
intro: Umlawuli onamandla, owaziwa ngobulumko bakhe obukhulu kunye netrone yakhe emangalisayo, ufumana umyalezo ongaqondakaliyo ovela kumthombo ongaziwayo. Olu nxibelelwano lungalindelekanga lucel’ umngeni kwiinkolelo zabo negunya, lubabeka kuhambo lwezopolitiko oluya kuvavanya ingqondo yabo kwaye ekugqibeleni lubakhokelele ekuvukeni okunzulu ngokomoya. Ungamtyhila na lo mlawuli kunye neziganeko ezaguqula ubukumkani babo bonke?
clues: Mna nabantu bam sasinqula ilanga, silandela iindlela zookhokho bethu.
Intaka, ihupoe, yayingumthunywa ongalindelekanga owandiphathela ileta evela kwinkokeli enamandla.
Ukuze ndivavanye ubulumko bomthumeli, ndithumele izipho ezixabisekileyo, kodwa zabuyiselwa, kuba umthumeli wayenobutyebi obukhulu kakhulu obuvela ku-Allah.
Ngaphambi kokuba ndifike nakwinkundla yomthumeli, itrone yam ezukileyo yathuthwa ngokungummangaliso apho ngephanyazo.
Ndakufika, ndabuzwa ukuba itrone ethuthiweyo yeyam na, ndaza ndaphendula ndathi, 'Kungathi yiyo kanye leyo.'
Ndangena kwiholo enkulu enomgangatho endandicinga ukuba lichibi lamanzi, kwaye ngelo xesha loloyiko, ndazithoba kunye noMprofeti uSulaiman ku-Allah, iNkosi yehlabathi.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
